title: VeloraOS 1.10.50 - Image Payload Hardening
releaseNotes: Fixes vision requests failing with Failed to load image or audio file.
Normalises browser image uploads to known-good PNG/JPEG before they enter Chat.
Validates Base64, image size and decoded PNG/JPEG signatures before sending images to Ollama.
Sends only the newest user turn's images to the vision model so stale attachments cannot break later requests.
Resizes images to a maximum 2048-pixel side to reduce VRAM pressure while retaining useful detail.
Keeps Image Intelligence, automatic local vision routing and GPU-first inference.
